svg.text: Tweaked Computers | Demand-driven tick cycle
PROPOSED DESIGN / one mod dispatcher / no per-entity tick loops / active subscriptions stay tick-responsive
EVENTS CREATE DEMAND
ONE SYNCHRONIZED on_tick(t)
MEMBERSHIP & SAFETY
1 Admit this actual tick
Validate saved header / monotonic clock / duplicate-tick guard.
Preserve spent credits; freeze existing render reservation.
Extract due deadlines only; future owners are not visited.
2 Lifecycle + output safety
Targeted invalidations and due non-power physical observations.
Check only current output owners; fail closed before callbacks.
Pending clone ports + undo settlement + native adoption.
Dirty monitor grouping / repair / cleanup only.
No custom power sweep; no native-carrier power sweep.
3 Observe ACTIVE subscribed inputs
One watched physical input/color observation per actual tick.
Check current path + connectivity; read when changed/initial/resync.
Apply independent filters; enqueue only real notifications.
No subscriptions -> no subscription tick work.
4 Deliver pending notifications
Pending monitor touch / resize and due topology transitions.
Use registered recipients, exact identities and saved cursors.
Enqueue work; never invoke a guest callback inline.
5 Admit DUE timers
Only due computers; preserve deadline and creation ordering.
Cancel queued events correctly; coalesce missed intervals.
Future timers sleep; deferred due work retains fair eligibility.
6 Dispatch READY computers
Stable ready-round snapshot; at most one item/computer/tick.
Fair program / Console arbitration on shared bounded credits.
Fresh authority before effects; native power checked only on use.
Remaining/new work joins a later round; no recursive dispatch.
7 Service pending presentation + maintenance
Dirty status art / due animation; due KV expiry reclamation.
Monitor capture -> prepare -> complete-group commit -> retire.
Only due/dirty open editor, dashboard and inspector sessions.
Keep native cursor blink, chart fairness and existing budgets.
Snapshot only after dispatch; preserve last complete image.
8 Park completed owners; retain unfinished work
Remove empty memberships; keep paid progress and fair retries.
No registry-wide cleanup or demand-discovery pass.
No demand -> constant bookkeeping until an event/deadline.
Native lifecycle events
Build / revive / platform build / remove / die
Clone / rotate / object destroyed
Blueprint / settings paste / undo / redo
Deconstruction / force / surface changes
Update exact identity membership.
Mark only affected repair/group/status work.
Never execute player source in load callbacks.
Guest operations
Register / cancel timer -> deadline
Subscribe / unsubscribe -> watched input
Output write / clear -> owner safety set
Draw / change settings -> pending display
Message / click / touch -> recipient queue
Stop / fault / replace -> retire old demand
Each mutation updates its own membership.
Player UI events
Open / close / tab / leave / scope change
Console submission -> ready computer
Open viewer -> refresh membership
Close viewer -> remove its UI work
Local inspection is not a guest subscription.
No scan of all players to find open windows.
Necessary scheduled observations
Every tick: subscribed inputs + output safety
Due: interested topology / idle physical checks
Due: timers / KV expiry / status animation
Due or dirty: open UI / retained service jobs
Keep existing latency and work envelopes.
Delayed idle checks never authorize a call.
Autonomy means owning eligibility
An entity requests work; it does not own on_tick.
Static phase hooks may check empty lanes.
No actor framework or new public task API.
Native circuit timing is still Factorio-owned.
Only subscribed inputs are watched
No subscription: zero signal-work visit.
Waiting computer + subscription: observe input.
Changed input: queue its named handler.
Shared input read != shared authority or filter.
Native change hint is an optimization, not truth.
Explicit retained work sets
Ready computers + generation
Indexed next deadlines + owner
Watched input/color + subscribers
Owned outputs + current writer
Interested topology / pending adoption
Dirty displays / jobs / open UI sessions
Remove membership when demand ends.
Electrical policy
All custom composite devices: no electricity.
No power helpers, brownout pause or blanking.
Both radar tiers + native speaker: unchanged.
Check native power on method/metadata use
and receiving-radar transmission eligibility.
No proactive native power observation.
Save / reload / migration
Retain ordering, deadlines, baselines, progress
and already-spent same-tick credits.
One-time upgrade builds missing memberships
and removes only owned old power helpers.
Ordinary on_load: no source/world mutation.
No startup, output, sound or packet replay.
Unknown state stays recoverable and inert.
Safety is not optional work
Fresh identity / generation / force / surface
Selected-wire proof + last-writer ownership
Explicit sample failure; no silent missed pulse
Bounded queues / fair shared execution
Complete-frame publication / no partial result
Cancellation and no stale replacement access
Next actual simulation tick: revisit only live demand.
Planning artifact, not a runtime result. Full hook mapping, migration and verification gates are in design.md and tasks.md.
